company.description:
TBTM is a mobile application designed to help people share memories, revisit past moments, and engage with nostalgic content through a social and interactive platform. The app allows users to rediscover photos, posts, and events from previous years while connecting with friends and communities around shared memories.
TBTM focuses on the idea of “Throwback” culture, enabling users to relive meaningful experiences and milestones. The platform organizes past content and presents it in an engaging way, encouraging users to reflect on their journeys and share memorable moments with others.
